---
title: "Pingüinos de Palmer"
format:
  dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    theme: cosmo
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# Si falta algún paquete, instalar con:
# install.packages(c("palmerpenguins", "dplyr", "ggplot2", "plotly", "DT"))

library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)

datos <- penguins |> filter(!is.na(sex))
```

## Row {height=20%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Total de pingüinos"
list(
  icon = "clipboard-data",
  color = "primary",
  value = nrow(datos)
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Especies"
list(
  icon = "bar-chart",
  color = "info",
  value = length(unique(datos$species))
)
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Peso promedio (g)"
list(
  icon = "graph-up",
  color = "success",
  value = round(mean(datos$body_mass_g), 0)
)
```

## Row {height=80%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Largo vs profundidad del pico"
p <- ggplot(datos, aes(x = bill_length_mm, y = bill_depth_mm, color = species)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Largo del pico (mm)", y = "Profundidad del pico (mm)", color = "Especie") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p)
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Cantidad por especie"
ggplot(datos, aes(x = species, fill = species)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(x = "Especie", y = "Cantidad") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Peso corporal por especie"
ggplot(datos, aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Especie", y = "Peso corporal (g)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Datos

```{r}
#| title: "Tabla completa"
datatable(datos, options = list(pageLength = 10))
```
